name: Logout clears session and redirects to login
description: When a logged-in user clicks logout, their session is cleared and they are redirected to the login page.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page and log in as manager
Verify the dashboard is displayed after login
Click the logout button or menu item
Verify the user is redirected to the login page
Try to navigate directly to the dashboard URL
Verify the user is redirected back to the login page, confirming the session was cleared
